name: SupDance Canvas
description: Connect WorkBuddy to your signed-in SupDance canvas to inspect the current canvas and selection, and prepare image prompts. Image generation runs only when explicitly requested.
description_zh: 连接已登录的 SupDance 画布，查看当前画布与选区并准备图片提示词；仅在明确要求时发起生图。
description_en: Connect your signed-in SupDance canvas to inspect the current canvas and selection, and prepare image prompts. Generate images only when explicitly requested.
examples_zh: 打开我最近的 SupDance 画布并概括当前节点
分析当前画布中选中的提示词和图片
在当前画布配置一个图片提示词流程，先不要生成
examples_en: Open my recent SupDance canvas and summarize its nodes
Analyze the selected prompts and images on my current canvas
Prepare an image prompt flow on my canvas without generating yet
